classification: Posthoc economic-risk hypothesis after signal, portfolio and multiscale experiments; all outcomes retained
hypothesis: Low beta stock selection may miss broad rising-market risk premia; test observable market gates instead of calendar-year switching
beta: Past 252 daily returns OLS with intercept against CSI300; minimum 202 finite pairs
cyclical_score: 0.5 cross-sectional percentile of beta + 0.5 percentile of existing five-day reversal

candidates.R0_Cyclical: Always cyclical score, exposes the unconditional risk premium control
candidates.R1_MA200: Cyclical score if signal-close CSI300 > past200-close average; otherwise unchanged Equal8
candidates.R2_ROC252: Cyclical score if signal-close CSI300 > close252 trading days ago; otherwise unchanged Equal8

execution: E2 Buffer30/60, no leverage; identical base and cost/capacity stress settings
no_claim: High beta return is not automatically stock-selection alpha; rules are not an exact replication of the reference's US long-short strategy
stop: No optimization of lookback, gate threshold, beta/reversal mixing coefficient or year-specific parameters
